preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain control of owner account)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the automatic swap and liquidity mechanism. This will prevent token sales and liquidity additions, effectively stopping transactions and freezing funds in the contract. The owner can also manipulate other critical parameters like _maxTxAmount, maxWalletToken, or set fees to extreme values to disrupt normal contract operations.
